title: Canonical Reference Extraction Rules for Mode-I Phase-Field Fracture

rejection_of_u_0020.rationale: u <= 0.0020 mm (N=800) includes early pre-peak compliance and reduces tangent stiffness to ~137.35 kN/mm. The canonical reference stiffness K0 across Gates 1, 2, 6A, 6B is strictly defined on u <= 0.0010 mm (N=400).

force_sign_convention.physical_interpretation: Tensile vertical displacement (uy > 0) applied at top reference point produces negative reaction force (RF2 < 0). Tensile force F is defined positive: F = -RF2.
force_sign_convention.strict_rule: Absolute value substitution |RF2| is strictly forbidden to prevent concealing potential sign inversions or erroneous boundary condition reversals.

work_integration.extrapolation_description: Trapezoidal work integration must strictly evaluate only within the available, evaluated displacement range [0, u_final] and must never extrapolate beyond solved frames.

layer_mapping.layer1_disp_uel: Elements 1 .. Nphys (U1, U2 displacement degrees of freedom)
layer_mapping.layer2_phase_uel: Elements Nphys+1 .. 2*Nphys (Phase field U1 = d degree of freedom)
layer_mapping.layer3_companion_umat: Elements 2*Nphys+1 .. 3*Nphys (CPE4 companion elements for stress/energy output)

state_variable_mapping.SDV17: E_frac (element fracture surface energy in kN*mm == J)
state_variable_mapping.SDV18: E_elas (element elastic strain energy in kN*mm == J)

deduplication_rule.name: single_value_per_unique_elementLabel
deduplication_rule.mechanism: track seen = set() over elementLabel in ODB output
deduplication_rule.rationale: Companion CPE4 elements output 4 Gauss-point records per element sharing the same elementLabel. Aggregating all 4 points would inflate total energy by 4x. Single-value deduplication takes exactly one record per unique physical element.

governance_policy.explanation: Standard Abaqus / UEL energy outputs represent post-processed spatial quadrature. Residual differences Delta_book reflect algorithmic compliance, incrementation dynamics, and spatial integration rather than hard pass/fail criteria.

13897_element_adaptive_mesh.strict_rule: The 13,897-element mesh is strictly an efficiency-calibrated 2% adaptive configuration. It must never be represented as the literal 1% Pandey & Kumar mesh or as having identical node-element connectivity.
